sections.intent: Tell the firm's founding narrative in a compelling, personal way that distinguishes Hearthstone from transactional legal practices and creates emotional alignment with the visitor.
sections.headline: A Practice Born from Personal Experience
sections.body: Founding attorney Eleanor Marsh began her career at a large regional firm, where she watched families navigate the chaos of losing a loved one without a plan in place. She saw estates tied up in probate for years, sibling relationships fractured over ambiguous wills, and grieving spouses left without access to basic funds. In 2009, she opened Hearthstone Law with a singular mission: to make thoughtful, thorough estate planning accessible to every family — not just the wealthy few. Today, the firm has helped over 1,400 families across the region put plans in place they can trust.

sections.headline: Plans Designed for Every Stage of Life

items.title: Last Will & Testament
items.description: A legally binding document that specifies how your assets will be distributed, names guardians for minor children, and appoints an executor to carry out your wishes. Ideal for individuals and families at any asset level.

items.title: Revocable Living Trust
items.description: A flexible trust that holds your assets during your lifetime and transfers them to beneficiaries without probate. Maintains privacy and allows you to retain full control while you are living.

metadata.ideal_for: Homeowners, those with significant assets, blended families

items.title: Durable Power of Attorney
items.description: Designates a trusted agent to manage your financial affairs — paying bills, managing investments, filing taxes — if you become unable to do so yourself.

metadata.ideal_for: All adults, especially those with aging parents or health concerns

items.title: Healthcare Directive & Living Will
items.description: Documents your medical treatment preferences and designates a healthcare proxy to make decisions on your behalf if you are incapacitated.

items.title: Special Needs Trust
items.description: Provides for a family member with disabilities without disqualifying them from government benefits such as Medicaid or SSI. Carefully structured to supplement, not replace, public assistance.

metadata.ideal_for: Families with a disabled child or dependent

items.title: Business Succession Planning
items.description: Ensures your business continues smoothly after your retirement, incapacity, or death. Includes buy-sell agreements, ownership transfer strategies, and key-person planning.

sections.intent: Explain the firm's process so visitors understand what working with Hearthstone actually looks like, reducing anxiety about getting started.
sections.headline: From First Conversation to Signed Documents — We Guide Every Step
sections.body: Our process begins with a complimentary consultation where we listen to your goals, family situation, and concerns. From there, we design a customized plan, walk you through every document in plain language, and refine it until it perfectly reflects your wishes. Once signed and executed, we store your plan securely and invite you back for a complimentary review every three years — or whenever a major life event occurs.
